inputs.prompt: A man is fast asleep in bed at night, lying on his back with his hands folded on the duvet. He breathes slowly and deeply: with every breath his chest, his shoulders and his folded hands rise clearly and then sink again, about one full breath every four seconds. Nothing else moves. His eyes stay closed and his face stays peaceful and still; his lips stay closed. The lamp glows steadily. The phone lying on the bedside table stays dark and still. The camera pushes in toward him extremely slowly and smoothly. Quiet night, soft room tone. One continuous shot with no cuts, no music, no speech, no subtitles and no text.
